analyst_view.overall: Union are 16th and winless in four; Leipzig are 4th with four wins in five and host Lens in the Champions League three days later, so some rotation is possible (Starting11 notes they already keep only 60% of their XI). Union's week has gone badly: Ligainsider and Comunio report top scorer Janik Haberer resting with illness and Trimmel, Uduokhai and Burcu missing training or carrying knocks, none of which the numbers know. Leipzig miss Guiu, Ouédraogo and Finkgräfe (counted) plus defender Esteve (one tracker). No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. I lean lower by 5%, to about 2.85: Union's top scorer Haberer is ill and Burcu missed training (Ligainsider, Comunio), on top of an attack that has already struggled (48 shots in six), and Leipzig may rotate before Lens. Neither is on the numbers' list; Union's poor form is already counted.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, already cut for both sides' low recent corner counts (Union 18, Leipzig 22 in six). Rotation and Union's absences do not clearly push corners either way, so I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards and already add Union's rough recent run (18 cards in six). No referee is named; Uduokhai and Trimmel being doubtful changes who defends for Union but gives no clear reason for more or fewer cards, so I stay at 3.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.1 shots and already cut Union's shots 13% for their recent drought. I go 4% lower, to about 24.1, because Haberer's illness and Burcu's absence thin Union further and a rotated Leipzig front line before the Champions League may take a little volume out.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. Same reasons as shots: Union lose their top scorer to illness and Leipzig may rotate before Lens, so I go 4% lower, to about 8.9. Leipzig's recent accuracy (+8%) is already counted.
